name: spielraum-chatgpt
description: Model apartments and multi-floor houses through chat with the Spielraum planner.

interface.longDescription: Start empty and add named floors, room divisions, doors, windows and straight stairs through chat. Explore each floor using Spielraum’s existing 2D/3D planner.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Spielraum and help me model my home. Ask about its floors, dimensions and room layout.
